description: This file defines an enumeration for various HTTP headers used within the security component of the Eclipse Ditto gateway service. It provides constants for common headers like Authorization, X-Correlation-Id, and pre-authentication headers, along with utility methods for retrieving headers by name and converting enum constants to strings.

classes.name: HttpHeader
classes.description: An enumeration representing specific HTTP header names used in the application's security layer.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an Optional<HttpHeader> based on a string name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string name of the HTTP header.
